label: Test checklist for the prototype. Not legal, customs or tax advice.

items.checked_by: Stored number without an identifier gap; two-source confirmation or seller confirmation

items.requirement_en: Side confirmed and UK wording available
items.requirement_ar: تأكيد الجانب وتوفر وصف الجانب البريطاني
items.checked_by: Left or right placement without a side gap and corridor UK wording
Condition state and cosmetic damage array, including an explicit empty array

items.requirement_en: Testing status disclosed; no working claim without a test record
items.requirement_ar: توضيح حالة الفحص وعدم الادعاء بالتشغيل دون سجل فحص
items.checked_by: Testing status without a blocking testing gap; claim guard removes unsupported working claims
Positive numeric weight and length, width and height
Corridor packing alert present; actual packing remains to be verified

items.requirement_en: Not a hazardous item: side mirror, no battery or airbag
items.requirement_ar: ليست مادة خطرة: مرآة جانبية دون بطارية أو وسادة هوائية
items.checked_by: Sourced seller hazard declaration; unknown without that declaration
Draft separates test reference data from unverified donor evidence and requires part-number matching
seller_approval.approved is true and approved_at is present; unknown until seller approval

items.requirement_en: UK import VAT on low-value consignments: verify with the official source
items.requirement_ar: ضريبة الاستيراد البريطانية للشحنات منخفضة القيمة: تحقق من المصدر الرسمي
items.checked_by: Reference only; no rates or thresholds asserted

items.requirement_en: Commodity code candidate 7009.10 for vehicle rear-view mirrors: verify with the official source
